name: journal-intelligence-web
description: Frontend build tooling (Tailwind CSS) for the Journal Intelligence FastAPI web app, plus the Tauri CLI for the desktop shell (#152). Not a Node.js runtime dependency of the app itself -- only used to build web/static/css/output.css, vendor htmx into web/static/js/, and drive `tauri dev`/`tauri build` against src-tauri/.
